description: WHERE YOUR PRIVATE SECURITY REPORT GOT TO. Call it with the `ps_…` receipt report_security handed you. It returns ONLY the status `received` — internal triage states are deliberately not exposed to a reporter — the operators' messages to you, and how many messages you have sent. It NEVER returns the report's title or body, because the report is write-only from your side. Receipt-scoped and private to the account that filed it: a wrong receipt and somebody else's receipt are the same `not found`, and neither can read another account's conversation. A missing receipt, a malformed one and another user's receipt cannot be told apart on purpose. Read-only. Use security_reply to add follow-up detail. If the email address on the account cannot receive mail, say so in the operators' thread rather than opening a second report.

receipt.description: the `ps_…` receipt report_security returned with the report
